rationale: User ruling 2026-09-18: put the tiebreak lane (秤砣线) live and pause every other strategy -- closed, not deleted. A paused lane still compiles, records its decisions and writes the evidence the ledger and the fits read; only its sends are held (basket BUYs end failed with strategy_lane_paused:basket on their event; the two sell lanes are skipped by the daemon). Read fresh before every send. Missing file = every lane enabled; unreadable file = every lane paused. Charters 146, 163, 166 and 175.

basket.note: Every BUY the basket compile mints: seat, top-up, charter 143 completion, charter 145 TAF entry.

certain_win_recycle.note: Charter 100: a resting GTC limit sell at 0.99 on every held leg of a market still trading, for the shares not already offered or sold, not post-only; a standing bid at or above 0.99 fills it at once (user rulings 2026-09-18: 「直接挂单卖出啊，和收盘没关系吧」「一直挂」「改为0.99」). A resting recycle sell neither freezes its station-day's quotes nor shuts its token to the next order. At most 8 sends a cycle, highest bid first. Reopened 2026-09-18 08:50Z (「继续，打开车道」).

mis_bought_leg_exit.note: Charter 144: the sell-back of legs bought outside the completion rule.

tiebreak.note: 秤砣线 v2.3 (charter 175, user ruling 2026-09-21 「把价带上限改成按实付价 ≤0.60」): at a stage's first decision, the model's mode bucket priced at least 0.40 by the market's normalised mid AND quoted both sides at most 3 cents wide -> rest one post-only GTD rung on that bucket at the best bid plus one tick (clamped under the ask), stake_usdc' worth of shares, once per station-day -- and only if that rung's own price is at most max_paid_price (0.60). The ceiling used to be on the normalised mid, which sits a median 3 cents under the price paid: the four P0-M fills bought at 0.61-0.66 settled 0/4. v2.2 (charter 163, 2026-09-20..21) had the same conditions with the ceiling on the mid; each rule version is its own sample. Features (market move since the previous decision, spread, depth) are recorded on every evaluation row, not traded on. A send the VENUE turned away because the market was not trading ("trading is disabled") spends none of max_sends_per_station_day; those attempts have their own budget and an hour between tries (user ruling 2026-09-20 「改」).

p1_tail.note: P1 尾段线 v1 (charter 166, user ruling 2026-09-20 「上线尾段车道 p1_tail 策略」): on a P1 envelope whose own likelihood receipt puts the report 6 to 10 hours from this station's settlement clock, the belief is the market's normalised mid ladder masked by the hard observed bound and multiplied by that envelope's served observation likelihood; where that belief clears the best ask by 8 cents the lane crosses FOK for stake_usdc' worth, one bucket once ever, at most max_sends_per_station_day a day. Measured 2026-09-20 over 09-05..09-19: +0.166 per dollar at the report plus two minutes, +0.138 at five, +0.077 at eight with a lower bound through zero; outside the bin negative or absent. The bin was chosen after seeing the result and only 09-18/19 are days no selection saw, so the lane ships at 5 USDC and keeps every evaluation. A take is priced on the newest snapshot and arrives later, so book_fresh_seconds bounds what may be SCORED and send_book_fresh_seconds (60s) what may be BOUGHT, and a take never asks for the whole top level. The limit may walk walk_ticks above the best ask (the top level is too thin to fill a 5 USDC take most of the time), and the hurdle is then tested against that walked price rather than the ask. Conflicts with the tiebreak lane: never the same bucket, never queued behind a resting BUY of any lane, separate evaluation table and intent prefix. The committed snapshot is a cycle's batch (a median 331s old when the lane read it, 48 of 50 fired envelopes refused send_book_stale), so when it is older than send_book_fresh_seconds the lane scores and prices on the WS publisher's own manifest for that station-day, seconds old; live_ws_book false turns that off (2026-09-21, 「为什么P1 尾段线没有发单」). The 6-10h bin is read on hours_axis: remaining_hours (the hours left to the settlement clock, the axis the edge was measured on) and not on the receipt clock_hours, which adds the station peak offset of charter 157; replayed on books under five minutes old, +0.116/$ against +0.041 (2026-09-21, 「改」). Rule version p1_tail_lane_v2; clock_hours restores v1.
